mechanism: Tobramycin is nephrotoxic and can impair renal function, potentially increasing mesalamine accumulation and its metabolite N-acetyl-5-aminosalicylic acid (N-Ac-ASA) levels, which may cause renal toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) before and during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; assess mesalamine dose appropriateness based on renal status.
